main_text.l: tio imperfectionis nostræ adminiculo nobis esset ad veram pietatem, nunquam sacrosan-&to Evangelio Christi dicta hæc confignata fuissent, Cùm orâtis, dicite, Dimitte nobis de-bita nostra. Ubi Primò, Autor qui dixit erat Christus, qui est ipsa veritas. Secundò, Cùm VOS orâtis, dixit,compellans Discipulos suos, in pietatis schola instructissimos. Tertiò, Dimitte DEBITA. Non igitur à delictis prorsus immunes. Quando vero & quoties orandum illis erat? CVM, inquit, orâtis: ut significet eos, quoties orant, hac petitione ac supplicatione opus habere. Nec tamen bona opera dignitate suâ spoliamus.

l.i: Protestantes veriorem & illustriorem dignitatem bonorum operum profitentur, quàm Pontificii solent.

main_text.l: BOna opera duplicem dignitatem fortiun-tur: unam ex principio operandi, qui est Spiritus sanctus: alteram ex statu operantis, qui est conditio adoptionis per Christum Jesum. Prius de principio. In omni verè Christiano homine duplex est homo: internus, & exter-nus; id est, carnalis, & spiritualis. Exinde de-

page.notes: The initial "B" is a large woodcut-style letter joined to "ona". The long s is rendered as s throughout. The word after "sacrosan-" is doubtful: printed as an ampersand-like form, read as "&to" [?] (probably "ƈto"). The thesis line "I THESIS." is treated as a numbered thesis label. The heading "De dignitate bonorum operum:" keeps its printed colon. "dixit,compellans" is printed without a space and is kept as printed. A stray mark at the lower left of the text block is not printed text and is left out. Show-through from the facing page is left out.
